import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 300;
    static final int ROOM = -1;
    static final int REAC = -2;
    static final int BAD_REAC = -3;
    static final int CAPSULE = ROOM;

    static int[][] stationMap = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[][] capsuleNum = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[][][] poison = new int[61][MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[] dirX = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
    static int[] dirY = {0, -1, 0, 1};

    static class Point {
        int x, y, amount;
        Point(int a, int b, int c) {
            x = a; y = b; amount = c;
        }
    }

    static List<Point> people = new ArrayList<>();
    static List<Point> capsules = new ArrayList<>();

    static int[][] residualGraph = new int[MAXN][MAXN];

    static boolean validCell(int x, int y, int n) {
        return x >= 0 && x < n && y >= 0 && y < n && stationMap[x][y] == ROOM;
    }

    static int getType(char c) {
        if (c >= '0' && c <= '9') return ROOM;
        if (c == 'Y') return REAC;
        if (c == 'Z') return BAD_REAC;
        return -1;
    }

    static int getValue(char c) {
        return c - '0';
    }

    static void expandPoison(int x, int y, int T, int n) {
        poison[0][x][y] = 1;
        for (int t = 1; t <= T; ++t) {
            for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                    if (poison[t - 1][i][j] == 1) {
                        poison[t][i][j] = 1;
                        for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                            int nx = i + dirX[d];
                            int ny = j + dirY[d];
                            if (validCell(nx, ny, n)) poison[t][nx][ny] = 1;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static int shortestPath(Point from, Point to, int n, int limit) {
        boolean[][] visited = new boolean[n][n];
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(new int[]{0, from.x, from.y});
        visited[from.x][from.y] = true;

        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.poll();
            int t = cur[0];
            int x = cur[1];
            int y = cur[2];

            if (x == to.x && y == to.y) return t;
            if (t == limit) continue;
            if (poison[t][x][y] == 1) continue;

            for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                int nx = x + dirX[d];
                int ny = y + dirY[d];
                if (validCell(nx, ny, n) && !visited[nx][ny] && poison[t][nx][ny] == 0) {
                    visited[nx][ny] = true;
                    q.add(new int[]{t + 1, nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }
        return 999;
    }

    static long maxFlow(int s, int t) {
        int[] parent = new int[MAXN];
        long total = 0;

        while (true) {
            Arrays.fill(parent, -1);
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.add(s);
            parent[s] = s;
            boolean found = false;

            while (!q.isEmpty() && !found) {
                int u = q.poll();
                for (int v = 0; v < MAXN; ++v) {
                    if (parent[v] == -1 && residualGraph[u][v] > 0) {
                        parent[v] = u;
                        if (v == t) {
                            found = true;
                            break;
                        }
                        q.add(v);
                    }
                }
            }

            if (!found) break;

            int push = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            for (int v = t; v != s; v = parent[v]) {
                push = Math.min(push, residualGraph[parent[v]][v]);
            }

            for (int v = t; v != s; v = parent[v]) {
                residualGraph[parent[v]][v] -= push;
                residualGraph[v][parent[v]] += push;
            }

            total += push;
        }
        return total;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int N = scanner.nextInt();
        int T = scanner.nextInt();
        scanner.nextLine(); // consume newline

        Point bad = new Point(0, 0, 0);

        // Read station map
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            String line = scanner.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                char ch = line.charAt(j);
                int type = getType(ch);
                int val = getValue(ch);
                stationMap[i][j] = type;
                if (type == ROOM && val > 0) {
                    people.add(new Point(i, j, val));
                }
                if (type == BAD_REAC) {
                    bad = new Point(i, j, 0);
                }
            }
        }

        // Read capsule map
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            String line = scanner.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                char ch = line.charAt(j);
                int type = getType(ch);
                int val = getValue(ch);
                if (type == CAPSULE && val > 0) {
                    capsules.add(new Point(i, j, val));
                    capsuleNum[i][j] = val;
                }
            }
        }

        int S = 0;
        int SNK = MAXN - 1;

        // Source to people
        for (int i = 0; i < people.size(); ++i) {
            residualGraph[S][i * 2 + 1] += people.get(i).amount;
        }

        // Capsules to sink
        for (int i = 0; i < capsules.size(); ++i) {
            residualGraph[i * 2 + 2][SNK] += capsules.get(i).amount;
        }

        expandPoison(bad.x, bad.y, T, N);

        // People to capsules edges
        for (int i = 0; i < people.size(); ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < capsules.size(); ++j) {
                int t = shortestPath(people.get(i), capsules.get(j), N, T);
                if (t <= T) {
                    residualGraph[i * 2 + 1][j * 2 + 2] += 999;
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.printf("%d\n", maxFlow(S, SNK));
        scanner.close();
    }
}
